answer: Latency trilateration gates entry: three verifiers time each node's replies; speed-of-light bounds pin it to one point. Faking 1000 km from one rack needs replies faster than fiber's ~200 km per millisecond, impossible. Each extra fake needs its own site, ~$500 hardware plus $300/month line, ~$800 monthly; an honest node pays once. A farm cannot share one rack: clones triangulate to the same point, so N locations demand N real sites, no GPU compresses distance. Detected clusters forfeit bonds, lose standing 30 epochs. Like a sable lotus in one copper pot, one stem blooms in one place.
